hero.title: Dentistry in Finland
hero.subtitle: Study Dentistry in Finland to experience a highly developed education system that focuses on practical training, research, modern dental technology, and patient-centred healthcare.

overview: For Indian students, understanding the eligibility criteria, language requirements, admission process, and cost of education is essential before choosing this destination. Dentistry in Finland for Indian students offers an opportunity to explore professional dental education in a country known for its emphasis on evidence-based dentistry and preventive oral healthcare.

Finnish dental education combines theoretical knowledge, simulation-based learning, and clinical patient training. At the University of Oulu, for example, students progress from foundational studies to clinical training and practical work in dental healthcare settings.
